qualification: Experience in Java, C++, Python, or Go; basic understanding of algorithms and data structures.
description: Work on core product features, scalability, and internal infrastructure directly impacting billions of users.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: Graduate students, young professionals, and artists from participating countries.
qualification: Completed undergraduate degree equivalent; strong academic record and English proficiency.
description: Enables international graduate students and young professionals to study and conduct research at universities in the United States.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open to entry-level developers globally with strong web technology fundamentals.
qualification: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Vue.js; familiarity with Git workflow.
description: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to build, test, and ship clean user interfaces across the GitLab platform.

title: Associate Data Scientist
eligibility: Recent graduates with a degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or quantitative fields.
qualification: Experience with Python, R, SQL, machine learning frameworks, and data visualization tools.
description: Apply advanced statistical methods and machine learning models to extract actionable insights from large datasets.

title: Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university worldwide.
qualification: Passion for technology, software development, AI, and entrepreneurship.
description: Global student technology competition encouraging participants to build innovative AI applications that solve real-world social problems.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide, no prior programming experience required.
qualification: Basic computer literacy and interest in problem-solving.
description: An entry-level course covering algorithmic thinking, data structures, software engineering, and languages like C, Python, SQL, and JavaScript.
